milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul lantern is at spawn-relative (0, 4, 4) on top of a 3-high cobblestone wall post at the structure entrance. The player must approach within 5 blocks and face toward it (facing_tolerance=60°) to demonstrate they have identified and located the soul lantern beacon. max_distance=5 is appropriate because the player spawns ~4 blocks away but needs to actively orient toward the lantern rather than just standing at spawn.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined item ends up in inventory. The scene provides a Silk Touch iron pickaxe which ensures lime stained glass drops as an item when broken (without Silk Touch, glass drops nothing). There are 8 lime stained glass blocks inside the structure at spawn-relative positions (-1 to 1, 2-3, 7) and (-2 to 2, 2, 8). The player must mine at least 1 block and collect it.
